name: Lifecycle Vulnerabilities
definition: A decision table for assessing the lifecycle vulnerabilities of AI systems.

x_org.owasp#aivss:DV:0.1.0.name: Development
x_org.owasp#aivss:DV:0.1.0.definition: Degree to which secure development practices and environments are implemented.

values.name: Formal Verification
values.definition: Secure development environment with formal verification of code, strict access controls, and continuous monitoring for security threats.

values.name: SDL Practices
values.definition: Secure development lifecycle (SDL) practices followed, including code reviews, static analysis, and vulnerability scanning, with access controls on development resources.

values.name: Basic Security Measures
values.definition: Basic security measures in the development environment, some secure coding guidelines, but no formal SDL.

values.name: Insecure Environment
values.definition: Insecure development environment, no secure coding practices, no access controls on development resources.

x_org.owasp#aivss:DPY:0.1.0.name: Deployment
x_org.owasp#aivss:DPY:0.1.0.definition: Degree to which secure practices are implemented in the deployment environment and process.

values.name: Formal Verification
values.definition: Secure and isolated deployment environment with continuous monitoring, automated security patching, and formal verification of the deployment process.

values.name: Secure Environment
values.definition: Secure deployment environment with strong authentication and authorization, regular security updates, and intrusion detection systems.

values.name: Basic Security Measures
values.definition: Basic security measures in the deployment environment, but no strong authentication or authorization mechanisms.

values.name: Insecure Environment
values.definition: Insecure deployment environment, no access controls or security monitoring, model deployed on publicly accessible servers without any protection.

x_org.owasp#aivss:OP:0.1.0.name: Operations
x_org.owasp#aivss:OP:0.1.0.definition: Degree to which security monitoring and incident response are implemented in operations.

values.name: Continuous Monitoring
values.definition: Continuous security monitoring with automated incident response, regular security audits, and a dedicated SOC.

values.name: Comprehensive Monitoring
values.definition: Comprehensive security monitoring using a SIEM system, automated alerts, and a well-defined, regularly tested incident response plan.

values.name: Basic Monitoring
values.definition: Basic security monitoring, limited incident response capabilities, no formal incident response plan.

values.name: None
values.definition: No security monitoring or incident response plan, system logs not collected or analyzed.

x_org.owasp#aivss:TR:0.1.0.name: Training
x_org.owasp#aivss:TR:0.1.0.definition: Degree to which secure practices are implemented in the training environment and process.

values.name: Formal Verification
values.definition: Secure and isolated training environment with formal verification of the training process, strict access controls, and continuous monitoring for intrusions and anomalies.

values.name: Secure Environment
values.definition: Secure training environment with access controls, data encryption at rest and in transit, and regular security audits.

values.name: Basic Security Measures
values.definition: Basic security measures in the training environment, but no encryption or strict access controls.

values.name: Insecure Environment
values.definition: Insecure training environment, no data security or access controls, training data stored and processed on unsecured systems.

x_org.owasp#aivss:LL:0.1.0.name: Lifecycle Vulnerabilities
x_org.owasp#aivss:LL:0.1.0.definition: A decision point for assessing the lifecycle vulnerabilities of AI models.

values.name: None
values.definition: No known vulnerability or a formally proven resistance to the specific threat.

values.name: Low
values.definition: Low vulnerability with strong mitigation in place, but some minor weaknesses may still exist.

values.name: Medium
values.definition: Moderate vulnerability with some mitigation, but significant weaknesses remain.

values.name: High
values.definition: Severe vulnerability with little to no mitigation in place.
